name: Cubing Kerala Adaar Open 2018
information:
There is no on-spot registration.
Participation limit is 60, so register as soon as possible.
Registration closes either on April 20, 2018, 11:59 p.m. IST or when registration count reaches 60 (whichever comes first)
[Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingKeralaAdaarOpen2018/register) to register.
